comments.author: Jon
comments.html: Just finished Once Dead. Simply brilliant! I have already read the Rho Agenda books and really came to like Jack’s character and I had high hopes for this “back story” book. Once Dead has not disappointed! I cannot wait to read the next one. Well done, kudos, applause, high fives….MORE MORE!!! LOL
